name: toggle
title: Toggle
purpose: Represent an independent two-state action as a pressed surface or an outline-to-solid icon.

composition.semantic: A native button exposes modelValue through aria-pressed.
composition.icon: Icon type uses paired outlined and filled bookmark, heart, star, pin, bell, or flag MDI glyphs without changing the control surface.
composition.migration: The former boolean Toggle moved to Switch; this component is intentionally not a compatibility alias.

accessibility: Keep visible text or provide an accessible name for icon type.
Preserve native button focus and Space/Enter activation.
commonMistakes: Using Toggle for a boolean form setting.
Omitting an accessible name from an icon-only toggle.
